youthAction.title: Youth wetland research in action
youthAction.subtitle: From starter projects to international collaboration—pathways, tools, and mentors.

cards.title: Take the first step: observe, record, identify
cards.body: Begin with “water detectives,” wetland plant ID, or a microplastic starter kit—simple sampling, logging, and analysis to build research habits.

cards.title: Advanced research: from biodiversity to remote sensing
cards.body: Advanced tracks cover biodiversity assessment, soil carbon, urban wetland health; expert tracks include remote sensing, DNA barcoding, and international comparisons.
